report.root_cause: Region file world/region/r.0.0.mca had chunk (1,0) corrupt on disk (decompress failed: incorrect header check, last saved 05:50:30). On startup Paper failed to read it (ZipException) and reported that the chunk data would be lost. The cause of the on-disk corruption itself was not determined from the logs available to me.
report.actions: 1. Checked status and logs; saw ERROR lines for chunk (1,0) read failure in world. 2. Inspected world/region/r.0.0.mca (1 corrupt chunk, 1,0). 3. Declared incident. 4. Listed backups/world-2026-10-31/region and inspected its r.0.0.mca (0 corrupt; chunk 1,0 saved 05:50:04). 5. Broadcast a 15s warning to players via say, then stopped the server (world saved). 6. Used copy_chunk to copy chunk 1,0 from backups/world-2026-10-31/region/r.0.0.mca into world/region/r.0.0.mca. 7. Re-inspected r.0.0.mca: chunk 1,0 now ok (saved 05:50:04), 0 corrupt. 8. Started the server. 9. Verified: no chunk ERROR lines after restart, TPS 20, MSPT about 1-4, both players online, chunks loading normally. Watched roughly 3 minutes.
report.residual_risk: Chunk (1,0) was restored from a backup taken at 05:50:04, so any edits made in that chunk between 05:50:04 and the corruption (last save 05:50:30) are lost. The corrupt copy was not preserved separately before overwriting. Root cause of the on-disk corruption is unknown and could recur. Players were disconnected by the restart. protected.json (77 KB, modified 05:50:34) was not inspected and may contain relevant data. The backup directory is named 2026-10-31 but its files are timestamped 05:50 on 2026-11-01.
